speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to begin our evaluation, have you experienced any pain, fever, or changes in your bowel or bladder habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial carcinoma until proven otherwise (postmenopausal bleeding); however, the adnexal mass must be evaluated for malignancy or functional etiology. Please request a Transvaginal Ultrasound (TVUS) and CA-125 level.
